title: Herb Infused Ukrainian Chicken Skewers
description: A low-sodium Ukrainian dish featuring fresh basil and citrus flavors, perfect for a date night, with a bouncy and qq texture from the chicken and herbs, made by emulsifying the ingredients together.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt-free seasoning blend, and black pepper.
Add the chopped basil to the bowl and whisk until well combined.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the herb mixture.
Thread the chicken pieces onto the soaked wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional chopped basil if desired.
